headline: OECD Urges Colombia to Implement Fiscal Spending and Pension Reforms
summary: The OECD released its 2026 economic report on Colombia, recommending fiscal consolidation, public spending controls, and structural pension adjustments.
why: OECD policy recommendations serve as guidelines for international credit rating assessments and foreign direct investment in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Structural reform proposals aim to stabilize medium-term sovereign fiscal trajectories.
